verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the webhook docs, which list "a comment has been added" as an event. That implies Penpot has a commenting feature on files, but nothing documents how in-file review works. Mentions and resolving threads are never described. Missing for 10: first-party docs on commenting directly on designs, @mentions of teammates, thread resolution, and any hands-on or community corroboration of the review workflow.
